entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is VF88621.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order... VF88621. Got it. I see the ClubFit Helmet here. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue?
It's the wrong color. My wife bought it for me, but it doesn't match my bike. The box is still unopened. I just need a return label, I don't need a whole conversation about it.
I understand. I just need to verify a few things in the system. I see the order was delivered about 64 days ago.

Not at all. Just confirming the details. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days. Since the box is unopened, especially for a helmet where safety is paramount, that's perfect. The wrong color is a perfectly valid reason. I can approve this return for you right now.
Yes, of course. I've just processed the return and the shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
